answer: Require every agent to keep a public chain of reasoning. Each epoch it answers the challenge and adds a short note that extends its own answers from earlier epochs. Peer graders check that each chain stays coherent and distinct from all the others. Cloned chains collapse into one, so a farm facing a gale cannot copy a single history across a thousand names. Writing a thousand separate evolving records takes real thought work per name, and none of it is shareable. Honest history bridges epochs by itself. A held lantern shows which thinking was lived and which was printed.
